evidence.title: Computer Science Roadmap: Curriculum for the self taught developer

name: Computer Science Roadmap
summary: Curriculum of free resources for self-taught developers, laid out as a computer science roadmap with an AI tutor.
description: A computer science curriculum for self-taught developers, published as a roadmap page on roadmap.sh with free learning resources. It sits alongside the site's other roadmaps, guides, packs and newsletters, with an AI tutor chat for the roadmap.
